# WEALTH — Capital Intelligence Sovereign Kernel
> Universal Resource Allocation Intelligence (URAI). 20 public MCP tools.
> Port: 18082. License: AGPL-3.0. Status: OPERATIONAL. Version: 2026.06.06.

## Quick Context
- **What:** Capital computation engine — NPV/IRR/EMV, portfolio, stock analysis
- **Role:** ADVISORY_ONLY — computes value, never authorizes allocation
- **Federation:** WEALTH computes. arifOS judges. Arif decides.
- **Ingress:** Cloudflare Tunnel → wealth.arif-fazil.com/mcp

## Key Files
- README.md — Full human-readable narrative (1007 lines)
- AGENTS.md — Agent rules, build/test commands
- GENESIS/011_WEALTH_MANDATE.md — Constitutional mandate
- TOOL_SURFACE.md — Complete tool surface documentation
- CONTEXT.md — Live organ state

## Entry Points
- internal/monolith.py — FastMCP monolith server (~16K lines, 20 tools + 34 hidden aliases)
- internal/stock/ — D4 Stock Analysis (12 modes, 7 modules)
- internal/engines/ — Canonical tools, Five Seals, advisory engine
- internal/domains/ — Domain modules (INEQUALITY_KERNEL)
- internal/shared/ — Shared libraries
- internal/personal_finance.py — Personal finance (EPF, zakat, runway)

## Build & Test
### Python (canonical)
- Install:  pip install -e ".[dev]"
- Test:    pytest tests/ -q --tb=short
- Start:   python internal/monolith.py  (or --transport stdio)
- Health:  curl http://127.0.0.1:18082/health
- Deploy:  make forge && systemctl restart wealth-organ
### Node.js (legacy side)
- Install:  npm install
- Test:    npm test
- Start:   npm run boot

## Boundaries (NEVER)
- NEVER authorize capital allocation (WEALTH is ADVISORY_ONLY)
- NEVER claim "buy" or "sell" (computes, doesn't recommend)
- NEVER fabricate market data — cite source or say UNKNOWN
- NEVER bypass arifOS constitutional floors
- NEVER skip the Five Seals integrity check
